items.question: What comprehensive result follows from worship of the letter ka?
premises: The letter ka is worshipped.
All worships are encompassed in that act.
Such worship yields a complete result.
items.inference: Worship of the letter ka constitutes the worship of all.
items.plain_english: O auspicious one, from the worship of the letter ka, the worship of all would be accomplished.

items.question: What status and reward does the worshipper of the letter ka attain?
premises: The worshipper performs the prescribed worship.
Such worship confers the status of a divine hero.
The fruit of all worship is obtainable.
items.inference: That worshipper becomes a divine hero and obtains the fruit of all worship.
items.plain_english: He indeed would become a divine hero and would obtain the fruit of all worship.

items.question: What enduring nature characterizes the one who embodies all worship?
premises: The worshipper is identified with all worship.
This identification extends to all states of being.
The condition is constant.
items.inference: He is always composed of all worship and all states.
items.plain_english: He also is always composed of all worship and composed of all states of being.

items.question: How can an ignorant person effectively mutter the śakti-mantra?

items.inference: An ignorant person cannot truly mutter the śakti-mantra.
items.plain_english: O great goddess, how could that ignorant person mutter the śakti-mantra?

items.question: What manifests as the body of the deity in this practice?

items.inference: One should always contemplate Kālī and the thirty-letter vidyās such as Chinnā.
items.plain_english: Always contemplate Kālī and the vidyās beginning with Chinnā, consisting of thirty letters.

items.question: What contemplative act follows after performing the chosen meditation?

items.inference: After the chosen meditation, one should contemplate within the middle of the heart.
items.plain_english: Then, having performed the chosen meditation, one should contemplate in the middle of the heart.

items.question: What arises merely from a fully blossomed meditation?
